facts.fact: The AfDB/MAPS assessment says Mauritius' e-Procurement System (e-PS) went live on 28 September 2015 with the first electronic Invitation for Bid, published by the Mauritius Police Force, and bidding runs through it.
The assessment says Mauritian law mandates the e-PS for all open advertised bidding and requires all public bodies to use it, while finding use selective and bid evaluation and award often offline.

systems.platform: commercial off-the-shelf system customised locally, hosted on the Government Cloud run by the Government Open Center

MUS.note: No figure for use is given: the document says only that a small percentage of procurement value goes through the e-PS.
